blocks.text: by — bitta predlog, bir nechta ma'no

**by** ning eng oddiy ma'nolari qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 111-dars): **by** car, **on** foot, a book **by** Navoi. Bu darsda uning barcha asosiy ma'nolarini bir joyga yig'amiz. O'zbekchada **by** ga bitta so'z mos kelmaydi — har bir ma'no o'z tarjimasiga ega: «poyezd**da**», «email **orqali**», «karta **bilan**», «tasodif**an**», «... **tomonidan**», «deraza **yonida**», «10 foiz**ga**». Shuning uchun **by** ni o'zbekchadan emas, ma'nodan kelib chiqib tanlash kerak. Uning yana uch ma'nosi boshqa darslarda: **by** Friday — jumagacha, kechiktirmay (→ 120-dars), **by** myself — yolg'iz o'zim (→ 83-dars), **by** + -ing — «... orqali» (→ 60-dars).

rows: poyezdda, email orqali, karta bilan, qo'lda
10 foizga oshmoq, ikki gol farq bilan yutmoq

blocks.text: Qanday yo'l bilan? by car, by email, by card

**by** + **artiklsiz** ot — usul yoki vosita turi. Transport: **by** car, **by** coach, **by** underground, umumiy yo'l turlari — **by** road, **by** rail, **by** air, **by** sea. Aloqa: **by** email, **by** post, **by** phone, **by** text, **by** courier. To'lov: **by** card, **by** cheque, **by** bank transfer — lekin naqd pul **in** cash (→ 127-dars). Qo'l mehnati — **by hand** (qo'lda), yod olish — **by heart**. Muhim qoida: ot oldida artikl yoki egalik so'zi paydo bo'lsa, **by** ishlatilmaydi va joy predlogi keladi: **in** my car, **on** the 8.15 train (→ 124-dars), **in** an email, **on** the phone. Piyoda — **on foot**.

items.text: We went to Bukhara **by train** and came back **by plane**.
Can I pay **by card**? — Sorry, cash only.
items.translation: **Karta bilan** to'lasam bo'ladimi? — Kechirasiz, faqat naqd pul.

items.text: I'll send you all the details **by email** tonight.
items.translation: Barcha tafsilotlarni sizga bugun kechqurun **elektron pochta orqali** yuboraman.

blocks.text: by chance, by accident, by mistake

Uch ibora ham «rejalashtirilmagan» degan ma'noni beradi, lekin ohangi har xil. **by chance** — tasodifan, hech kim rejalashtirmagan, ko'pincha yoqimli yoki betaraf voqea. **by accident** — beixtiyor, bilmasdan, niyatsiz qilingan ish (ko'pincha ko'ngilsiz natija). **by mistake** — adashib, noto'g'ri narsani tanlab yoki xato qilib. Teskarisi — **on purpose** (ataylab, → 127-dars). Xushmuomala savolda **by any chance** — «tasodifan ... emasmi?»: Are you Kate's brother, **by any chance**?

rows: We met **by chance** at the airport.

blocks.text: Kim tomonidan? Majhul nisbat va muallif

Majhul nisbatda ish-harakatni kim yoki nima bajarganini **by** ko'rsatadi (→ 42-dars): The bridge was designed **by** a Japanese engineer. O'zbekchada bu «... **tomonidan**» yoki, tabiiyroq, faol gap bilan beriladi: The tree was hit **by** lightning — Daraxtga chaqmoq urdi. Asar muallifi ham **by**: a novel **by** Qodiriy, a painting **by** Behzod, a song **by** Yulduz Usmonova — o'zbekchada qaratqich `-ning`. «of» ishlatilmaydi. **by** + -ing esa harakatning **usulini** bildiradi: You can save time **by booking** online — Onlayn band qilish **orqali** vaqtni tejash mumkin. Asbob esa **with**: cut it **with** a knife.

items.text: The new bridge was designed **by a Japanese engineer**.
I love this old song **by Yulduz Usmonova**.
items.translation: **Yulduz Usmonovaning** bu eski qo'shig'ini juda yaxshi ko'raman.

items.text: You can save a lot of money **by booking** your tickets early.
items.translation: Chiptalarni erta **band qilish orqali** ancha pul tejash mumkin.

blocks.text: **by** joy predlogi sifatida «**naq yonida**, yonginasida» degani: **by** the window, **by** the door, **by** the fire, **by** the sea (dengiz bo'yida), **by** the river. U **near** dan kuchliroq: **near** the station — vokzal atrofida, yaqin joyda; **by** the station — vokzalning yonginasida. Harakat fe'llari bilan **by** — «yonidan o'tib»: walk **by**, drive **by**, go **by** (vaqt ham: as the years went **by**).
by + farq: by 10%, by two goals, by far

O'zgarish va taqqoslash fe'llaridan keyin **by** farqning **miqdorini** ko'rsatadi: increase / rise / go up / fall / drop / cut / reduce **by** 10% — 10 foiz**ga** oshmoq / kamaymoq; win / lose / beat **by** two goals — ikki gol **farq bilan**; miss the bus **by** five minutes — avtobusga besh daqiqa**ga** kechikmoq. «on 10%» yoki «for 10%» — xato (bu rus tili ta'siri). **by far** — «shubhasiz, ancha»: the best **by far**. Birlik bo'yicha: paid **by the hour** (soatbay), sold **by the kilo** (kilolab). Takroriy iboralar: **one by one** (birma-bir), **step by step** (bosqichma-bosqich), **little by little** (asta-sekin), **day by day** (kundan-kunga).

items.text: Rents in the city centre have risen **by 8%** this year.
items.translation: Bu yil shahar markazida ijara narxi **8 foizga** oshdi.

items.text: We lost the final **by one point**, which was heartbreaking.
items.translation: Finalda **bir ochko farq bilan** yutqazdik — bu juda alamli bo'ldi.

items.text: Our new flat is right **by the metro station**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I came with car» → **by car**; «by my car» → **in my car**; «by foot» → **on foot**; «pay with card» → **pay by card**; «pay by cash» → **pay in cash**; «send with email» → **send by email**; «a novel of Qodiriy» → **a novel by Qodiriy**; «increased on 10%», «increased for 10%» → **increased by 10%**; «cut it by a knife» → **cut it with a knife**; «I did it by purpose» → **on purpose**.

O'zbekchadan yo'l: «poyezd**da** / mashina**da**» (tur sifatida) → **by**; «... **orqali**» (email, pochta, o'qish orqali) → **by**; «... **tomonidan**», «muallif**ning**» → **by**; «... **yonida**, **bo'yida**» → **by**; «... foiz**ga**», «... farq **bilan**» → **by**. Lekin «pichoq **bilan**», «ruchka **bilan**» (asbob) → **with**.

Bog'lanish: by va until, by the time — 120-dars; majhul nisbat (is done / was done by ...) — 42-dars; predlog + -ing (by doing) — 60-dars; by myself / on my own — 83-dars; on the bus / in a car — 124-dars; in cash, on purpose — 127-dars.

rows: artikl yoki egalik bo'lsa — by emas
usul — by; aniq xat yoki suhbat — in / on

examples.title: **by** car, **by** rail, **by** air — and **on** foot
examples.description: by + artiklsiz transport: by train, by coach, by underground, by ferry; yo'l turlari — by road, by rail, by air, by sea. Artikl yoki egalik bilan — on the 7.40 train; piyoda — on foot.

sentences.text: It's quicker to get to Samarkand **by train** than **by car**, and much more comfortable.
sentences.translation: Samarqandga **poyezdda** borish **mashinada** borishdan tezroq va ancha qulayroq.

sentences.text: Most of the goods arrive at the port **by sea** and then travel inland **by rail**.
sentences.translation: Tovarlarning aksariyati portga **dengiz orqali** keladi, keyin ichki hududlarga **temir yo'l orqali** jo'natiladi.

sentences.text: Do you go to work **by bike** even in winter? — Only when it isn't snowing.
sentences.translation: Qishda ham ishga **velosipedda** borasizmi? — Faqat qor yog'mayotganda.

sentences.text: We travelled round Scotland **by coach**, which was cheap but slow.
sentences.translation: Shotlandiya bo'ylab **avtobusda** sayohat qildik — arzon, lekin sekin edi.

sentences.text: The fastest way to cross London is **by underground**, unless there's a strike.
sentences.translation: Ish tashlash bo'lmasa, Londonni kesib o'tishning eng tez yo'li — **metroda**.

sentences.text: Tom usually comes **by car**, but today he came **on the 7.40 train**.
sentences.translation: Tom odatda **mashinada** keladi, lekin bugun **7:40 dagi poyezdda** keldi.

sentences.text: Is the castle far from here? — No, it's only ten minutes **on foot**.
sentences.translation: Qal'a bu yerdan uzoqmi? — Yo'q, **piyoda** atigi o'n daqiqa.

sentences.text: Sending large parcels **by air** is expensive, so we usually send them **by road**.
sentences.translation: Katta posilkalarni **havo yo'li bilan** jo'natish qimmat, shuning uchun ularni odatda **avtomobil yo'li orqali** yuboramiz.

sentences.text: Bekzod hates flying, so he crossed the Caspian **by ferry** on his way to Baku.
sentences.translation: Bekzod samolyotda uchishni yomon ko'radi, shuning uchun Bokuga ketayotib Kaspiydan **paromda** o'tdi.

sentences.text: How did you get here so fast? — **By taxi**; the driver knew a shortcut.
sentences.translation: Bu yerga bunchalik tez qanday yetib kelding? — **Taksida**; haydovchi qisqa yo'lni bilardi.

examples.title: **by** email, **by** post, pay **by** card
examples.description: Aloqa va to'lov usuli — by: by email, by post, by courier, by phone, by text, by letter; pay by card, by cheque, by bank transfer (lekin in cash). by hand — qo'lda, by heart — yoddan.

sentences.text: Could you send me the invoice **by email**? I'll pay it this afternoon.
sentences.translation: Hisob-fakturani menga **elektron pochta orqali** yubora olasizmi? Bugun tushdan keyin to'layman.

sentences.text: The original certificate has to be sent **by post**, not scanned.
sentences.translation: Asl guvohnoma skanerlanmasdan, **pochta orqali** yuborilishi kerak.

sentences.text: Can I pay **by card**, or do you only take cash?
sentences.translation: **Karta bilan** to'lasam bo'ladimi yoki faqat naqd pul olasizmi?

sentences.text: The tickets were delivered **by courier** the day after we booked them.
sentences.translation: Chiptalar band qilganimizning ertasiga **kuryer orqali** yetkazildi.

sentences.text: Our grandmother still makes all her bread **by hand**, just like her mother did.
sentences.translation: Buvimiz hamon barcha nonini xuddi onasidek **qo'lda** yopadi.

sentences.text: Madina learnt the whole poem **by heart** for the school competition.
sentences.translation: Madina maktab tanlovi uchun she'rni to'liq **yod oldi**.

sentences.text: You can book a table **by phone** or online, but not **by text**.
sentences.translation: Stolni **telefon orqali** yoki onlayn band qilish mumkin, lekin **SMS orqali** emas.

sentences.text: Most people now pay their bills **by bank transfer** rather than **in cash**.
sentences.translation: Hozir ko'pchilik hisoblarni **naqd pulda** emas, **bank o'tkazmasi orqali** to'laydi.

sentences.text: My father still pays the rent **by cheque**, which amazes our young landlord.
sentences.translation: Otam hamon ijara haqini **chek bilan** to'laydi, bu yosh uy egamizni hayratda qoldiradi.

sentences.text: Nobody contacts me **by letter** any more — except the bank!
sentences.translation: Endi hech kim men bilan **xat orqali** bog'lanmaydi — bankdan boshqa!

examples.title: **by** chance, **by** accident, **by** mistake
examples.description: by chance — tasodifan (hech kim rejalashtirmagan); by accident — beixtiyor, bilmasdan; by mistake — adashib, xato bilan; by any chance — xushmuomala savolda. Teskarisi — on purpose.

sentences.text: I met my best friend **by chance** on a train from London to Oxford.
sentences.translation: Eng yaqin do'stim bilan Londondan Oksfordga ketayotgan poyezdda **tasodifan** tanishganman.

sentences.text: Sorry, I deleted your file **by accident** while I was tidying up the desktop.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, ish stolini tartibga keltirayotganimda faylingizni **bilmasdan** o'chirib yubordim.

sentences.text: Somebody took my umbrella **by mistake** and left a very similar one.
sentences.translation: Kimdir soyabonimni **adashib** olib ketibdi va unga juda o'xshash boshqasini qoldiribdi.

sentences.text: Penicillin was discovered almost **by accident** in 1928.
sentences.translation: Penitsillin 1928-yilda deyarli **tasodifan** kashf etilgan.

sentences.text: Did you break it **on purpose** or **by accident**? — By accident, I promise!
sentences.translation: Uni **ataylab** sindirdingmi yoki **beixtiyor**? — Beixtiyor, qasamyod qilaman!

sentences.text: Jasur got on the wrong bus **by mistake** and ended up on the other side of the city.
sentences.translation: Jasur **adashib** boshqa avtobusga chiqib qoldi va shaharning narigi chetiga borib qoldi.

sentences.text: **By chance**, the hotel had one room left, so we didn't have to sleep in the car.
sentences.translation: **Tasodifan** mehmonxonada bitta bo'sh xona qolgan ekan, shuning uchun mashinada uxlashimizga to'g'ri kelmadi.

sentences.text: I sent the email to the whole company **by mistake** — it was meant only for Tom.
sentences.translation: Xatni **xato bilan** butun kompaniyaga yuboribman — u faqat Tom uchun edi.

sentences.text: Do you know if Sarah is free tonight, **by any chance**?
sentences.translation: **Tasodifan** bilmaysizmi, Sara bugun kechqurun bo'shmi?

sentences.text: The fire started **by accident** when a child was playing with matches.
sentences.translation: Yong'in bir bola gugurt bilan o'ynayotganda **beixtiyor** chiqib ketgan.

examples.title: Passive: built **by**, damaged **by**, used **by**
examples.description: Majhul nisbatda ish-harakatni bajaruvchi — by: was built by, was blown down by, is used by. O'zbekchada — «tomonidan» yoki tabiiyroq faol gap.

sentences.text: The Bibi-Khanym Mosque was built **by Amir Temur** after his campaign in India.
sentences.translation: Bibixonim masjidi **Amir Temur tomonidan** Hindiston yurishidan keyin qurilgan.

sentences.text: Hundreds of trees were blown down **by the storm** last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechasi **bo'ron** yuzlab daraxtlarni qulatib yubordi.

sentences.text: This app is used **by millions of students** around the world.
sentences.translation: Bu ilovadan butun dunyodagi **millionlab talabalar** foydalanadi.

sentences.text: Was the decision made **by the director** or **by the whole board**?
sentences.translation: Qaror **direktor tomonidan** qabul qilinganmi yoki **butun kengash tomonidan**mi?

sentences.text: Aziz was bitten **by a dog** while he was jogging in the park.
sentences.translation: Aziz bog'da yugurayotganda uni **it** tishlab oldi.

sentences.text: The new airport terminal will be opened **by the president** next month.
sentences.translation: Yangi aeroport terminali kelasi oy **prezident tomonidan** ochiladi.

sentences.text: Most of the damage was caused **by water**, not by the fire itself.
sentences.translation: Zararning aksariyatini olovning o'zi emas, **suv** keltirgan.

sentences.text: I was woken up at six **by the neighbours' dog**.
sentences.translation: Meni soat oltida **qo'shnilarning iti** uyg'otib yubordi.

sentences.text: Is the museum funded **by the government** or by private sponsors?
sentences.translation: Muzey **davlat tomonidan** moliyalashtiriladimi yoki xususiy homiylar tomonidanmi?

sentences.text: The thief was finally caught **by a young police officer** who recognised his face.
sentences.translation: O'g'rini oxiri uning yuzini tanib qolgan **yosh politsiya xodimi** qo'lga oldi.

examples.title: A novel **by** Qodiriy; improve **by** reading
examples.description: Muallif va ijodkor — by: a novel by Abdulla Qodiriy, a painting by O'rol Tansiqboyev, a piece by a young composer. by + -ing — qanday usul bilan: by watching, by working (→ 60-dars).

sentences.text: 'Bygone Days' is the most famous novel **by Abdulla Qodiriy**.
sentences.translation: «O'tkan kunlar» — **Abdulla Qodiriyning** eng mashhur romani.

sentences.text: Have you read anything **by Agatha Christie**? — Yes, all her Poirot books.
sentences.translation: **Agata Kristining** biror asarini o'qiganmisiz? — Ha, Puaro haqidagi barcha kitoblarini.

sentences.text: The concert opened with a piece **by a young composer** from Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Konsert toshkentlik **yosh bastakorning** asari bilan ochildi.

sentences.text: There's a beautiful landscape **by Ural Tansykbaev** in the hall of our school.
sentences.translation: Maktabimiz zalida **O'rol Tansiqboyevning** chiroyli manzara rasmi osig'liq.

sentences.text: You can improve your listening skills **by watching** films without subtitles.
sentences.translation: Subtitrsiz film **ko'rish orqali** tinglab tushunish ko'nikmangizni oshirishingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: Kate paid for her studies **by working** in a café every evening.
sentences.translation: Keyt har kech kafeda **ishlab**, o'qishi uchun pul to'ladi.

sentences.text: Who is this song **by**? I've heard it everywhere this summer.
sentences.translation: Bu qo'shiq **kimniki**? Bu yoz uni hamma joyda eshitdim.

sentences.text: The thieves got into the building **by breaking** a window at the back.
sentences.translation: O'g'rilar orqa tomondagi derazani **sindirib**, binoga kirishgan.

sentences.text: This poem **by Alisher Navoi** has been translated into more than twenty languages.
sentences.translation: **Alisher Navoiyning** bu she'ri yigirmadan ortiq tilga tarjima qilingan.

sentences.text: You won't save money **by buying** cheap shoes that fall apart in a month.
sentences.translation: Bir oyda titilib ketadigan arzon poyabzal **sotib olish bilan** pul tejab qololmaysiz.

examples.title: **by** the window, **by** the sea: right next to
examples.description: by — naq yonida: by the window, by the door, by the fire, by the river, by the sea. near dan ham yaqinroq. Harakat bilan — walk by (yonidan o'tib ketmoq).

sentences.text: Can we have a table **by the window**, please? We'd like to see the view.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, **deraza yonidan** stol bera olasizmi? Manzarani ko'rmoqchimiz.

sentences.text: They've bought a little cottage **by the sea** in Cornwall.
sentences.translation: Ular Kornuolda **dengiz bo'yida** kichkina uy sotib olishdi.

sentences.text: Leave your shoes **by the door** — the carpet has just been cleaned.
sentences.translation: Poyabzalingizni **eshik yonida** qoldiring — gilam hozirgina tozalangan.

sentences.text: We spent the evening sitting **by the fire**, drinking tea and telling stories.
sentences.translation: Oqshomni **olov yonida** o'tirib, choy ichib, hikoyalar aytib o'tkazdik.

sentences.text: There's a lovely café **by the river**, just past the old bridge.
sentences.translation: Eski ko'prikdan o'tgan zahoti **daryo bo'yida** ajoyib kafe bor.

sentences.text: Grandpa sat **by my bed** all night when I had a high fever.
sentences.translation: Isitmam baland bo'lganda bobom tun bo'yi **karavotim yonida** o'tirdi.

sentences.text: A man was standing **by the car**, staring at the flat tyre.
sentences.translation: Bir kishi **mashina yonida** turib, puchaygan g'ildirakka tikilib turardi.

sentences.text: Hundreds of people walk **by** our shop every day, but few come in.
sentences.translation: Har kuni do'konimiz **yonidan** yuzlab odamlar **o'tadi**, lekin kam kishi ichkariga kiradi.

sentences.text: Mum sat **by the phone** all evening, waiting for news from the hospital.
sentences.translation: Onam kasalxonadan xabar kutib, butun oqshom **telefon yonida** o'tirdi.

sentences.text: Is the hotel near the beach? — It's right **by the beach**; you can hear the waves.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona plyajga yaqinmi? — U plyajning **naq yonida**; to'lqinlar ovozi eshitilib turadi.

examples.title: **by** 15%, **by** two goals, **by** five minutes
examples.description: by + farq miqdori: go up / fall / cut by 15%; lose / win by two goals, by 300 votes; miss by five minutes; by far — shubhasiz. Birlik bo'yicha: paid by the hour, sold by the kilo.

sentences.text: The price of bread has gone up **by 15%** since January.
sentences.translation: Yanvardan beri non narxi **15 foizga** oshdi.

sentences.text: Our team lost **by two goals**, but we played much better than last time.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz **ikki gol farq bilan** yutqazdi, lekin o'tgan safargidan ancha yaxshi o'ynadik.

sentences.text: I missed the last bus **by five minutes** and had to walk home.
sentences.translation: Oxirgi avtobusga **besh daqiqaga kechikdim** va uyga piyoda borishga majbur bo'ldim.

sentences.text: The company plans to cut its energy use **by a third** over the next five years.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya keyingi besh yil ichida energiya sarfini **uchdan bir qismga** kamaytirishni rejalashtirmoqda.

sentences.text: Unemployment in the region fell **by 2%** last year.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili mintaqada ishsizlik **2 foizga** kamaydi.

sentences.text: Students who work in the café are paid **by the hour**.
sentences.translation: Kafeda ishlaydigan talabalarga **soatbay** haq to'lanadi.

sentences.text: At the bazaar, cherries are sold **by the kilo**, not by the box.
sentences.translation: Bozorda gilos qutilab emas, **kilolab** sotiladi.

sentences.text: This is **by far** the best plov I've ever eaten — what's your secret?
sentences.translation: Bu, **shubhasiz**, men umrimda yegan eng zo'r palov — sirringiz nima?

sentences.text: The candidate won the election **by just 300 votes**, so her opponent demanded a recount.
sentences.translation: Nomzod saylovda **atigi 300 ovoz farq bilan** g'alaba qozondi, shuning uchun raqibi ovozlarni qayta sanashni talab qildi.

sentences.text: Tom is older than his brother **by only eleven months**.
sentences.translation: Tom ukasidan **atigi o'n bir oy** katta.

examples.title: Mixed: one **by** one, step **by** step, day **by** day
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: transport, usul, tasodif, majhul nisbat, «yonida» va farq — by ning barcha ma'nolari; one by one, step by step, little by little, day by day iboralari.

sentences.text: The passengers got off the plane **one by one**, looking tired after the long flight.
sentences.translation: Yo'lovchilar uzoq parvozdan charchab, samolyotdan **birma-bir** tushishdi.

sentences.text: **Little by little**, Sarah's Uzbek improved, and soon she could chat with the neighbours.
sentences.translation: Saraning o'zbek tili **asta-sekin** yaxshilandi va tez orada qo'shnilar bilan suhbatlasha oladigan bo'ldi.

sentences.text: The instructions explain **step by step** how to set up the new router.
sentences.translation: Yo'riqnomada yangi routerni qanday sozlash **bosqichma-bosqich** tushuntirilgan.

sentences.text: Did you cut the bread **with a knife** or break it **by hand**?
sentences.translation: Nonni **pichoq bilan** kesdingmi yoki **qo'l bilan** ushatdingmi?

sentences.text: Bekzod found his old school photos **by chance** while he was clearing out the attic.
sentences.translation: Bekzod chordoqni tozalayotganda eski maktab suratlarini **tasodifan** topib oldi.

sentences.text: We sent the furniture **by sea**, but we flew to Edinburgh ourselves.
sentences.translation: Mebelni **dengiz orqali** jo'natdik, o'zimiz esa Edinburgga uchib bordik.

sentences.text: The kitchen window was smashed **by a football**, and the boys ran away.
sentences.translation: Oshxona derazasi **futbol to'pidan** sinib ketdi, bolalar esa qochib qolishdi.

sentences.text: Visitor numbers have increased **by 40%** since the museum opened its new hall.
sentences.translation: Muzey yangi zalini ochganidan beri tashrif buyuruvchilar soni **40 foizga** oshdi.

sentences.text: Emma sat **by the window** of the train, watching the fields go by.
sentences.translation: Emma poyezdning **derazasi yonida** o'tirib, o'tib borayotgan dalalarni tomosha qildi.

sentences.text: Things are getting better **day by day**, so don't give up.
sentences.translation: Ishlar **kundan-kunga** yaxshilanyapti, shuning uchun taslim bo'lma.
